description: Single registry of every dependency and static-analysis gate in CI, the severity each one blocks at, and every exclusion from those gates. scripts/check-security-gates.mjs fails the build when CI and this file disagree.

gates.step: Semgrep gate (unaccepted findings block the merge)

exclusions.reason: The lock files it compares live in ~/.claude on a developer machine, so in CI the step has nothing to read and its exit code carries no signal.
Unmaintained, unsound, and yanked warnings on transitive crates with no upstream replacement. RUSTSEC vulnerabilities are still blocking in the step above.
The Windows test binary fails to load with STATUS_ENTRYPOINT_NOT_FOUND from a cross-CRT DLL mismatch; Windows cargo check and clippy stay strict and the full test suite runs on Linux.
Triaged Semgrep findings accepted as supply-chain hardening debt. Every entry carries a rule, reason, owner, and expiry that scripts/check-semgrep-findings.mjs enforces.
Reviewed non-credential fixtures keyed on (path, format); an entry that stops matching fails the scan as stale.

RUSTSEC-2026-0258 (h2 unbounded empty DATA frames). The 0.4 line is patched to 0.4.16; h2 0.3.27 has no 0.3.x fix and is reachable only through hyper 0.14, which async-stripe 0.31 and oauth2 4.4 both pin. Both use it strictly as an HTTP client against Stripe and the identity provider, and the advisory rates it Low. Revisit when async-stripe 1.0 ships stable.
